description: Returns all test line items (accession_tests) for an accession, ordered by creation time.
validation: accession must exist and belong to organization + branch

errors.condition: accession not found / not in organization+branch scope

constraints: barcode_status CHECK IN (GENERATED, PRINTED, REPRINTED, CANCELLED)
sample_status CHECK IN (PENDING, COLLECTED, RECEIVED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, REJECTED)

notes: As of database/schema/032_sample_status_master.sql, accession_tests.sample_status is enforced by an FK to sample_status_master (organization_id, branch_id, sample_status_code) rather than the original hardcoded CHECK - the master table's currently seeded values are PENDING, COLLECTED, RECEIVED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, REJECTED, IN_TRANSIT, RECOLLECTION_REQUESTED (a superset of the original CHECK list). collection_status, authorization_status, and report_status remain plain CHECK constraints, not master-table driven.
